SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY）
File No. D. 4423
D.u 13 2 33
Date February 13, 1933.

Subject (in full) Communist publication entitled "Science Monthly".

Made by Det. Kuh Pe-hwu. Forwarded by A. J. Everett.

With reference to the attached file on the subject of
a communist publication entitled "Science Monthly" purporting
to emanate from the Japan Branch of the China Social Science
Society, I have to report that this publication is unknown
to this office. Endeavours made by the Chinese staff of
this Section to obtain information regarding the whereabouts
of this organization have failed.

Kuh Tao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别支部报告

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 中央与特别支部登记处）
档案编号 D. 4423
D.u 13 2 33
日期 1933年2月13日。

事由（全称） 题为《科学月刊》的共产主义出版物。

由警探顾佩虎（Kuh Pe-hwu，音译）撰写。由 A. J. Everett 转呈。

关于随附的档案，涉及一份题为《科学月刊》的共产主义出版物，据称由中国社会科学研究会日本分会发行，本处特此报告，本办公室对该出版物并不知情。本部门华籍职员为查明该组织下落所作的努力均未成功。

顾道华（Kuh Tao-hwa，音译）
侦探督察

特别支部主管警官。

归档
1933年2月15日。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch S. 3. Station
REPORT
File No.
Date February 2, 19 33.

Subject (in full) Communistic Publication
Entitled "Science Monthly".

Made by and Forwarded by C.D.I. Prince.

Sir,
Following our usual procedure we have endeavoured
to obtain a copy of the "Science Monthly" for perusal but
have not been able to do so, neither have we been able to learn
anything regarding the China Social Science Society from which
the publication is alleged to emanate.
Note has been taken of the information given in
the attached for future reference.

C. D. I.

O/C Special Branch.

S2.
Any information please?
M
3.2.33.

A. J. Kuhn.
APB 3/2/33.

事由（全称） 题为《科学月刊》的共产主义出版物。

由 C.D.I. Prince 撰写并转呈。

先生，
按照我们通常的程序，我们曾试图获取一份《科学月刊》以供审阅，但未能做到；我们也未能获悉任何关于据称发行该出版物的中国社会科学研究会的信息。
随附文件中提供的信息已记录在案，以备将来参考。

C. D. I.

特别支部主管警官。

S2.
如有任何情报请告知？
M

A. J. Kuhn.

D. 4423.

- January 19, 33.

Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your letter
No.7 of January 14 in regard to a periodical entitled
"Science Monthly" issued by the Japan Branch of the
China Social Science Society and to inform you that
the matter will receive attention.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) F. W. Goddard
Commissioner of Police.

General Wen Hung-en,
Chief of the Public Safety Bureau,
Greater Shanghai Municipality.

貴局本月十四日致字第七号
大函為查禁中國社會科
學研究會日本分會發行

從事查禁矣相應函覆即希
查照為荷此致

Translation of a Confidential Despatch, Character "政",
No.7, dated January 14, 1933, from the Bureau of Public
Safety.

To the Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sir,

This Bureau has received the following Confidential
Despatch No.485 from the Municipality of Greater Shanghai:-
"Letter No.571 has been received from the Special
District Kuomintang transmitting the following Secret
Despatch No.3948 from the Propaganda Department of the
Central Kuomintang Headquarters:-
'It is reported that a periodical known as
"Science Monthly" issued by the Japan Branch
of the China Social Science Society is a
communistic publication and should be banned.
The Post Office Censor has been instructed to
detain the said periodical'.
"All subordinate organs under you should be warned
to keep a sharp lookout for this paper".
My subordinates have been notified of the above
order, and I have to request you to instruct your officers
and men to keep a watch for the periodical.

WEN HUNG AN,
Chief of the Public Safety Bureau.
pages.zh:
1933年1月14日公安局发出的机密公函译文，字号“政”，第7号。

致上海公共租界工部局
警务处处长。

先生，

本局收到来自大上海市政府的以下机密公函第485号：
“收到特区国民党党部转来的国民党中央执行委员会宣传部秘密公函第3948号，内容如下：
‘据报，由中国社会科学研究会日本分会发行的名为《科学月刊》的期刊系共产主义出版物，应予查禁。邮政检查员已奉命扣留该期刊’。
“应警告阁下所属各下属机关对此报纸严加留意”。
上述命令已通知我的下属，现请阁下指示所属警员对该期刊保持监视。

文鸿安，
公安局局长。
